who.title: I don't teach how to live. I explore life together with you.
who.text: I write books and create games, guides and learning projects about what matters to me: a woman, her choices, her inner foundation, self-fulfilment, change and the chance to begin a new life at any age.
who.path: My own path became the foundation of many of my projects.

idea.title: JE SUIS means “I AM”
not: Not “how others want to see me”.
idea.outro: This is where my philosophy was born.

project.quote: The path of a woman who one day realises: the most important journey is the journey back to herself.
